objective_for_doctor:
Age: 8
Sex: M
Chief Complaint: extreme fatigue

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?
I’m extremely tired—I’m unable to do my usual activities or I’m stuck in my bed all day long. I also have a fever, chills or shivers, and a sore throat.
How many days have you had these symptoms, and did they come on suddenly or develop gradually?

I don't know. But I’ve had extreme fatigue where I’m unable to do my usual activities or I’m stuck in my bed all day long, along with a fever, chills or shivers, and a sore throat. I also have a cough and nasal congestion or a clear runny nose.
Are you experiencing any shortness of breath, chest pain, or difficulty breathing, especially at rest or with minimal exertion?
Is your cough dry, or are you bringing up phlegm or mucus?
Do you have significant muscle or body aches?

Yes—I have pain that feels heavy and exhausting, and it’s related to my reason for consulting. The pain is in the back of my head and the side of my neck (right and left), and my forehead and occiput, and it’s in the back of the neck area. The pain intensity is 3 out of 10.
Have you noticed any swollen or tender lymph nodes in your neck?
When you look at your throat in a mirror, do you see any white patches or pus on your tonsils?
Does your neck feel stiff, or is it painful to bend your chin down toward your chest?
Yes—it feels painful around the back of my neck, in the side of my neck (right and left) and also the back of my head and occiput.
[DDX] Influenza, COVID-19, Viral upper respiratory infection, Streptococcal pharyngitis, Meningitis
